_note: General guidance based on public hiring patterns. Not official statements from these companies. Review each entry and update lastReviewed when you do.

companies.name: Tata Consultancy Services
companies.summary: Solid programming basics, a consistent academic record and clear communication for large campus and off-campus drives.

expectations.academics: Mass-recruitment drives commonly set minimum aggregate marks across 10th, 12th and degree (often around 60%) and limit active backlogs. Always check the specific drive's eligibility.
expectations.experience: Freshers are hired in large numbers; internships and academic projects strengthen the profile.

emphasise: Core CS subjects and languages you actually know
avoid: Listing tools you can't answer questions on
resumePattern.atsNotes: Applications usually go through an online portal that parses your resume. Use a single-column layout, standard headings and a text-based PDF.

companies.name: Infosys
companies.summary: Logical reasoning, problem-solving and clean coding basics, backed by a steady academic record.

expectations.academics: Campus drives typically expect a consistent academic record without active backlogs; some specialist roles set higher cut-offs.
expectations.experience: Primarily fresher hiring for entry roles; specialist and higher-package roles reward stronger coding skills and projects.

avoid: Skill ratings like stars or bars
resumePattern.atsNotes: Keep headings standard (Education, Skills, Projects) so automated screening finds each section.

companies.name: Wipro
companies.summary: Aptitude, coding basics and adaptability for large-scale fresher hiring.

expectations.academics: Fresher programmes usually state minimum marks across 10th, 12th and degree and a cap on backlogs; read each programme's criteria.
expectations.experience: Freshers welcome; work-integrated programmes also hire non-engineering graduates in some years.

emphasise: One or two solid projects you can explain end to end
resumePattern.atsNotes: A clean, text-based PDF with standard section names parses best on large hiring portals.

companies.name: Accenture India
companies.summary: Communication, adaptability and business awareness alongside technical fundamentals.

expectations.academics: Eligibility is usually based on degree and year of passing with a consistent record; criteria vary by role and drive.
expectations.experience: Large fresher intake for associate roles; experienced hires are matched to specific capability areas.

resumePattern.length: 1 page for freshers, up to 2 pages with experience
avoid: Dense paragraphs; use short bullet points
resumePattern.atsNotes: Mirror the job title and key skills from the posting where they genuinely apply to you.

companies.name: Cognizant
companies.summary: Technical basics and aptitude for entry roles, with coding strength valued for higher tracks.

expectations.academics: Campus drives commonly expect a consistent record and no active backlogs; check each drive's eligibility.
expectations.experience: Freshers for entry tracks; stronger coding and projects open higher-paying tracks.

emphasise: Coding practice and contest results if you have them
Projects with clear technologies and outcomes
avoid: Claims you can't back up in a technical interview
resumePattern.atsNotes: Use plain bullet points and keep dates in one consistent format.

companies.name: HCLTech
companies.summary: Technical fundamentals plus readiness for infrastructure, engineering or software tracks.

expectations.academics: A consistent academic record is generally expected for campus hiring; criteria vary by programme.
expectations.experience: Fresher programmes plus lateral hiring for infrastructure, cloud and engineering services.

emphasise: Networking, OS or cloud certifications for infra roles
avoid: Irrelevant hobbies taking space from technical work
resumePattern.atsNotes: Group skills by type (Languages, Tools, Platforms) so they are easy to scan.

companies.name: Capgemini India
companies.summary: Aptitude, communication and coding basics, with a structured multi-round assessment.

expectations.academics: Fresher hiring usually sets minimum marks and backlog limits; check the drive notice.
expectations.experience: Freshers for analyst roles; experienced hires by capability.

resumePattern.atsNotes: Single-column layout with standard headings; avoid text inside images.

companies.name: Deloitte India
companies.summary: Analytical thinking, communication and business sense for consulting, audit, tax and technology roles.

skills: Domain knowledge for the role (tech, finance or risk)
expectations.academics: Strong academics help; some roles prefer specific degrees such as CA, MBA, B.Com or B.Tech.
expectations.experience: Campus hiring for analyst roles; internships in consulting, audit or analytics are a plus.

emphasise: Leadership roles in clubs or events
avoid: Purely technical jargon for business roles
resumePattern.atsNotes: Use the exact role title from the posting and keep bullet points action-led (Led, Analysed, Built).

companies.name: IBM India
companies.summary: Technical depth in cloud, data or AI basics, with curiosity and continuous learning.

expectations.academics: A solid academic record is expected; specific cut-offs vary by role.
expectations.experience: Freshers for associate developer and consulting roles; open-source and research work stand out.

resumePattern.length: 1 page for freshers, up to 2 pages with experience
resumePattern.atsNotes: Include the main technologies from the posting where they truly match your experience.

companies.name: Microsoft India
companies.summary: Strong data structures and algorithms, problem solving and impactful projects. Highly competitive.

expectations.academics: Strong fundamentals matter more than marks alone; good CGPA helps at campus stage.
expectations.experience: Internships at product companies, competitive programming and substantial projects stand out.

emphasise: Projects that show depth, not just tutorials
resumePattern.atsNotes: Recruiters scan quickly: put the strongest items at the top of each section and keep bullet points to one or two lines.

companies.name: Persistent Systems
companies.summary: Hands-on engineering skills and projects that show you can build and ship features.

expectations.academics: A consistent record helps; demonstrated coding ability carries significant weight.
expectations.experience: Freshers with strong projects; internships in product teams are valued.

emphasise: Projects with tech stack and your role
avoid: Skills you haven't used in a project
resumePattern.atsNotes: Name technologies exactly as they appear in the posting (for example 'React', not 'React-based UI').

companies.name: Mphasis
companies.summary: Technical basics plus interest in banking, insurance and financial-services systems.

expectations.academics: Campus drives usually expect a consistent record without active backlogs.
expectations.experience: Freshers and laterals; domain exposure to BFSI is a plus.

resumePattern.atsNotes: Include domain keywords (banking, payments, insurance) only where your work genuinely involved them.

companies.name: Happiest Minds Technologies
companies.summary: Modern tech skills (cloud, data, security, IoT) and a willingness to learn quickly.

expectations.academics: A consistent academic record is generally expected for campus hiring.
expectations.experience: Freshers with relevant projects; internships in cloud, data or security help.

emphasise: Projects in cloud, data, IoT or security
avoid: Buzzwords without a project to show for them
resumePattern.atsNotes: Group skills by area (Cloud, Data, Languages) to match how roles are posted.

companies.name: Tata Elxsi
companies.summary: Embedded, automotive or media-tech skills, or a strong design portfolio for design roles.

expectations.academics: Electronics, CS and design graduates are common; consistent academics help.
expectations.experience: Freshers with embedded or design projects; hardware lab work counts.

resumePattern.length: 1 page (engineering); portfolio link essential for design
emphasise: Embedded or automotive projects with hardware used
Tools (Keil, MATLAB, Figma) you actually used
avoid: Generic software-only resumes for embedded roles
resumePattern.atsNotes: List hardware platforms and protocols (CAN, I2C, SPI) explicitly when relevant.

companies.name: KPIT Technologies
companies.summary: Embedded and automotive software skills with strong engineering fundamentals.

expectations.academics: Engineering graduates in CS, ECE, EEE or mechatronics; consistent record expected.
expectations.experience: Freshers with embedded or automotive projects; student motorsport teams stand out.

emphasise: Competitions like student motorsport or robotics
resumePattern.atsNotes: Spell out acronyms once (for example 'Controller Area Network (CAN)') to match more search terms.

companies.name: Cyient
companies.summary: Engineering fundamentals across mechanical, electrical, software or geospatial work.

skills: CAD or GIS tools (for some roles)
expectations.academics: Hires across engineering branches; consistent academics expected.
expectations.experience: Freshers welcome; branch-specific projects and internships help.

emphasise: Projects linked to the role's domain
avoid: Skipping your core branch skills in favour of trendy topics
resumePattern.atsNotes: Name tools and versions exactly; engineering roles are often screened on specific software.

companies.name: Mastek
companies.summary: Enterprise application, data and cloud skills with clear communication.

expectations.academics: A consistent academic record is generally expected.
expectations.experience: Freshers and laterals; enterprise or data projects help.

emphasise: Enterprise tools you have used (Salesforce, Oracle, etc.)
resumePattern.atsNotes: Keep a clean, single-column layout and consistent date format.

companies.name: Intellect Design Arena
companies.summary: Product engineering skills with interest in banking and financial technology.

expectations.academics: Consistent academics expected; finance-related coursework is a plus.
expectations.experience: Freshers with strong projects; fintech internships help.

resumePattern.atsNotes: Describe projects with problem, technology and result so they read well to both ATS and recruiters.

companies.name: Sonata Software
companies.summary: Practical development skills across Microsoft platforms, cloud and data.

expectations.academics: A consistent academic record is generally expected.
expectations.experience: Freshers and laterals; Microsoft-stack projects or certifications help.

emphasise: Projects on Microsoft or cloud platforms
avoid: Listing every IDE and editor you've opened
resumePattern.atsNotes: Match platform names to the posting (Azure, Dynamics 365, Power BI) when you've used them.

companies.name: Sasken Technologies
companies.summary: Embedded, telecom and device software skills with strong C/C++ fundamentals.

expectations.academics: CS and ECE graduates are common; consistent record expected.
expectations.experience: Freshers with embedded or networking projects.

emphasise: Embedded Linux, drivers or networking projects
avoid: Vague project descriptions without the hardware or stack
resumePattern.atsNotes: Include low-level keywords you genuinely know (Linux kernel, device drivers, TCP/IP).

companies.name: Zerodha
companies.summary: Self-driven builders who show real, shipped work and depth in their craft.

skills: Strong programming in one language (Go, Python, etc.)
expectations.academics: Degrees and marks matter less than demonstrated skill and work.
expectations.experience: Open-source contributions and self-built projects are strong signals.

emphasise: Working projects with links and real users
What you built, not what you studied
resumePattern.atsNotes: Keep it simple and link to your work; reviewers often check GitHub directly.

companies.name: Razorpay
companies.summary: Strong problem solving, product sense and ownership of shipped features.

expectations.academics: Competitive at campus stage; skills and projects matter most.
expectations.experience: Internships at product companies and substantial projects stand out.

emphasise: Payments, APIs or high-scale work if you have it
Ownership of features end to end
resumePattern.atsNotes: Bullet points should start with an action verb and end with a result.

companies.name: CRED
companies.summary: High craft and attention to detail in engineering, design and product work.

expectations.academics: Skills and quality of work outweigh grades.
expectations.experience: Polished projects, design portfolios or product-company internships.

emphasise: Quality and polish of shipped work
Mobile apps on stores, if any
resumePattern.atsNotes: A clean, well-spaced one-pager reflects the craft they look for.

companies.name: Swiggy
companies.summary: Problem solvers who can work at scale and move fast on customer-facing products.

expectations.academics: Competitive campus hiring; skills and projects weigh heavily.
expectations.experience: Internships, scalable projects and analytics work stand out.

resumePattern.atsNotes: Use the posting's role title and core stack where they match your experience.

companies.name: Zepto
companies.summary: Speed, ownership and execution in a fast-growing operations-heavy business.

skills: Engineering, product or operations skills for the role
expectations.academics: Execution and ownership matter more than grades.
expectations.experience: Internships with measurable outcomes and initiative-driven projects.

emphasise: Things you launched or improved, with numbers
resumePattern.atsNotes: Short, outcome-focused bullet points work best.

companies.name: Meesho
companies.summary: Product-minded engineers and analysts who care about users in smaller cities and towns.

expectations.academics: Skills and projects outweigh marks.
expectations.experience: Product internships and user-facing projects help.

emphasise: Android or data projects with results
resumePattern.atsNotes: Describe impact on users, not just features built.

companies.name: Groww
companies.summary: Simple, reliable product thinking with strong engineering or analytics skills.

expectations.academics: Competitive; skills and projects weigh heavily.
expectations.experience: Product internships and projects with real users.

emphasise: Reliability and scale in your projects
resumePattern.atsNotes: Keep skills concise and grouped; highlight the ones the posting asks for.

companies.name: PhonePe
companies.summary: Engineering for scale and reliability on high-volume payment systems.

expectations.academics: Competitive campus hiring; strong fundamentals expected.
expectations.experience: Internships and projects that handle scale, concurrency or reliability.

resumePattern.atsNotes: Name the specific technologies (Kafka, Redis, Spring) you used, where true.

companies.name: Postman
companies.summary: Developer empathy and strong engineering for API tools used worldwide.

expectations.academics: Skills and projects matter most.
expectations.experience: Developer-tool projects, API work and open source stand out.

resumePattern.atsNotes: Link your GitHub and keep project descriptions technical and specific.

companies.name: Dream Sports
companies.summary: Engineering for high-traffic consumer products and a passion for sports.

expectations.academics: Competitive; strong fundamentals expected.
expectations.experience: Internships and projects that handle traffic spikes or real-time data.

resumePattern.atsNotes: Quantify scale where you can (users, requests per second, latency).
